lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: Well, Goku has passed, but his sacrifice has stopped a great evil.

lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: Thanks to him, our lives can return to peace once mor--

lines.speaker: Nappa
lines.text: Raaaditz? Raaaaaditz?

lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: What the hell is that?

lines.speaker: Nappa
lines.text: Guy-who's-as-strong-as-a-Saibaman-says "What?"

lines.speaker: Nappa
lines.text: That usually gets to him. I think he's dead, Vegeta.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Big shocker -- nobody cares. We're ten times stronger than him anyway.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: We'll go to Earth, find the Dragon Balls, and kill everyone!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: And we'll be there within a year or so.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: ...Depending on filler, of course.

lines.speaker: Nappa
lines.text: Aaanything else we need to go over, Vegeta?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Nope. That's about it.

lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: Well...
Wind whistling

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: All right, you little human... Saiyan... thing...

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: I saw what you did to that Saiyan back there.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: That kind of power can be useful.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Wh... What do you mean?

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: I'm going to make you my pupil, and then...

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: I'll use YOU for my conquest to take over the world!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: But... But where's my Daddy?

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Hate to tell you, kid, but your dad's DEAD!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Actually, I kind of like saying that.
Gohan cries

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Haha! Your dad's dea--!
Gohan cries

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Ah... damn it.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: This is why I hang out in wastelands.

lines.speaker: Heavenly Attendant
lines.text: Hello! And welcome to the Heavenly Check-In Station!

lines.speaker: Heavenly Attendant
lines.text: Please no cutting in line.

lines.speaker: Heavenly Attendant
lines.text: If you are caught cutting in line, you will be sent straight to Hell.

lines.speaker: Kami
lines.text: ...And so, we need Goku here to get to King Kai's for his masterful training, Lord Yemma.

lines.speaker: Yemma
lines.text: Give me one good reason I should allow this.

lines.speaker: Kami
lines.text: Because, if you don't, that line's going to increase by SIX BILLION!

lines.speaker: Yemma
lines.text: Six billion?!

lines.speaker: Yemma
lines.text: I'm supposed to be intimidated by six billion?!

lines.speaker: Yemma
lines.text: Please! I can judge six billion souls faster than you take a piss, old man!

lines.speaker: Kami
lines.text: You know, I am the Guardian of Earth.

lines.speaker: Kami
lines.text: Can I *please* get a little bit more respect here?

lines.speaker: Yemma
lines.text: Big deal! I'm the closest thing to a God in this show!

lines.speaker: Yemma
lines.text: Until you get to the Kais...

lines.speaker: Yemma
lines.text: ...then I'll be horrrribly insignificant.

lines.speaker: Yemma
lines.text: I do have a desk, though! It's made of mahogany!

lines.speaker: Yemma
lines.text: Ma-ho-gany.

lines.speaker: Kami
lines.text: Uhh, anyway, can we please--

lines.speaker: Yemma
lines.text: SILENCE!

lines.speaker: Yemma
lines.text: Mahogany...

lines.speaker: Kami
lines.text: Ummm... sir?

lines.speaker: Yemma
lines.text: Uh, what? Oh, uh, sure. Whatever.

lines.speaker: Yemma
lines.text: He can go to King Kai's... but he'll have to run on SNAAAAKE WAAAY!
Dramatic sting

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Sounds fun!

lines.speaker: Yemma
lines.text: Prepare to be surprised.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Alright, I'm off! Oh, wait.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: By the way... did you see a guy named Raditz come through here?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: He has spiky hair and a tail?

lines.speaker: Yemma
lines.text: Oh yeah, I remember that guy.

lines.speaker: Yemma
lines.text: I put him in my patented Yemma-lock!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: And it worked?

lines.speaker: Yemma
lines.text: F*** no! He kicked me in the balls and ran away!

lines.speaker: Yemma
lines.text: Now I don't know where he is.

lines.speaker: Raditz
lines.text: He didn't keep his eye on the birdie!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Huh. Okaay...

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Well, bye!

lines.speaker: Yemma
lines.text: See ya next time you die!

lines.speaker: Yemma
lines.text: ....Mahogany.

lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: So, Krillin, how did Chi-Chi take the news?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Ummm...
Flashback

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: Well, Krillin, what did you need to talk about?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: So, Chi-Chi. Hypothetically:

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: What would you do if you were told that your husband was dead, and your son were kidnapped by his worst enemy?

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: I'd castrate the messenger in his sleep with a rusty carving knife!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Then it's a good thing I'm not telling you that!
Krillin and Chi-Chi laugh

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: Would you like to spend the night?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Against my better judgment...
Ox King snoring
Sound of knife sharpening

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: ♪ Kriiilliiin, where arrree youuu? ♪

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: AaaaaAAAAUUUGH!!
Flashback ends

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Relatively well.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: So, are you going to grab the other Z-Warriors and go train with Kami?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: The who warriors?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: The Z-Warriors. You, Goku, Tien, Yamcha, Chiaotzu...

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: That's what we always call you guys.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: That's the stupidest thing I've ever--!

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: KRILLIIIN!! Where the hell are you!?!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Well, I'm off to gather the Z-Warriors! Bye!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: AAUGH-HA-HAAA...!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Listen up, runt! Today we're going to commence your intense training, under me.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: But wait... wouldn't that cause horrible muscle degeneration for somebody my age, crippling me for years to come?

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: ...You're a wordy little bastard, aren't you?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: My Mom wants me to become an ortho--

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: NERRRD!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Wha-what?

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Anyway, I figured to unleash your hidden potential, I'd have to put you in immense physical danger.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: So I'm going to throw you at that mountain.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Actually, that looks more like a plat--

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: EAAAAAAAUUUUUU...!
Gohan screams throughout his flight

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: 'Any second now...'

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: 'Here it commmmes...'

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: 'Aaaannd...!'
SPLAT

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Ewww...
Gohan crying

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: 'This is going to be a loooooong training session...'

lines.speaker: Heavenly Attendant
lines.text: All right, Mr. Muscle Man. Here you are at Snake Way.

lines.speaker: Heavenly Attendant
lines.text: Now; you might wanna pack a lunch because it's gonna be a long run.

lines.speaker: Heavenly Attendant
lines.text: Nah, I'm just jokin'; you're not going to be eating nothin'.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: WOW... That looks like it's going to take me a while.

lines.speaker: Heavenly Attendant
lines.text: Now, be careful running; you don't wanna fall off and die.

lines.speaker: Heavenly Attendant
lines.text: That's just a little bit of dead humor. But seriously; do not fall off or you will go to Hell.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Has anyone ever run the whole thing before?

lines.speaker: Heavenly Attendant
lines.text: Well, there was one man.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Well, who was he?

lines.speaker: Heavenly Attendant
lines.text: I believe his name was--

lines.speaker: Kami
lines.text: Mr. Popo!

lines.speaker: Mr. Popo
lines.text: Yes, Kami?

lines.speaker: Kami
lines.text: I just received word that we have a new batch of trainees coming.

lines.speaker: Kami
lines.text: Make sure you take good care of them.
Sinister laughter
Mr. Popo laughing; Psycho strings play
Mr. Popo laughing; insidious music

lines.speaker: Yemma
lines.text: And not just any mahogany; but mahogany from the planet of Malchior 7, where the trees are three-hundred feet tall and breathe FIRE!!

lines.speaker: Yemma
lines.text: From these trees, this desk was forged 2,000 years ago, using ancient blood-rituals of the Malchior people!
Malchiorians cackling

lines.speaker: Yemma
lines.text: Not only does this make my desk nigh *indestructible*, but it can bend the fabric of the Universe ITSELF!

lines.speaker: Yemma
lines.text: Also, it's a very fine material. Verrry expensive.

lines.speaker: Kami
lines.text: Oooookay--?

lines.speaker: Yemma
lines.text: It's mahogany.
